metaTitle: Custom Votive Sized Candles | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom votive sized candles for events or gifts. Perfect for bulk branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Votive sized candles offer a compact, elegant way to showcase your brand at events, in gift bags, or as corporate gifts. Their small footprint makes them ideal for table settings or favor giveaways, and the glass or tin holders can be customized with your logo using screen printing or labels. Choose from scents like the Bamboo Soy Candle or unscented options to match any occasion.
heroAltText: Custom votive sized candles in glass holders with branded labels, perfect for corporate gifts and events.
